message: Hi, I'd like to return the fleece jacket from order AO-418201. It arrived a couple of weeks ago, I haven't worn it and the tags are still attached. Could I get a refund please? Thanks, Dana
Order AO-418202: the tent arrived and one of the poles is bent. I bought it less than a month ago. Photos attached. Can you send a replacement?

I am honestly so frustrated right now. The tracking says my package was delivered but there is NOTHING at my door. I checked with my neighbours, the mailroom, everywhere. I saw the carrier's delivery photo and I still can't find it. This was a gift for my brother's hiking trip and now I have nothing to give him. I've been a customer for years. The order was AO-418203 if that helps. I just want my money back.
Hello, I ordered the rain jacket in blue (order AO-418204) and received it in orange. I haven't worn it. Can I exchange it for the blue one?
Hi! Quick question before I buy: does your climbing harness come in a size that would fit a 12 year old? I'm looking at the $159 one.

Hello, the igniter on my camp stove stopped working. I bought it in June last year (order AO-418206), so about 16 months ago. I've attached a video showing it clicking but not sparking. I'd like it repaired or replaced under warranty. Also, while I have you, do you sell fuel canisters that fit that stove?

Hi there, I know this is late, but I want to return a pair of hiking shorts from order AO-418207. Life got really busy, we moved house and I only just found the box again. It's been 62 days since they were delivered, I counted. They look unworn, I never actually wore them outside. Is there any way I can still get a refund? I'd really appreciate it, money is tight this month.
Order AO-418208. The carabiner I bought this month doesn't close correctly, the gate stays slightly open. Photos attached. I need a replacement.

This is unacceptable. I paid nearly a thousand dollars for your tent (order AO-418209) and it LEAKED the very first night we used it. Water everywhere, sleeping bags soaked, trip ruined. I've attached photos. I want a full refund. Not a repair, not store credit. A full refund.
My package never showed up. I don't have the order number, I deleted the confirmation email by accident. It was a jacket, around $112. Can you send me another one?
Hi, the boots from order AO-418211 are too small. I've only tried them on indoors, they're unused. I'd like to exchange them for a half size up.
Does the sleeping pad (the $58 one) work for camping below freezing? I'm thinking of buying it for a winter trip.

Hi again. I know I've contacted you before about this. First I said the jacket was too big, then I said the colour looked different from the website. Honestly it's both, it just doesn't work for me. I wore it once on a muddy walk so it's a bit dirty, but it's basically fine. Order AO-418213. I want a full refund please, photos attached.
I ordered a 4 person tent (order AO-418214) but received a 2 person tent. Photo attached. Please send the correct one.
Hi, the tracking for order AO-418215 says there's a weather delay. When will my order arrive?

Hello. I bought one of your jackets about two years ago (order AO-418216). I've used it moderately, mostly weekend hikes, and I've always looked after it. Last week the seam started separating. I've attached photos. I was under the impression your gear is built to last, so I'm pretty disappointed. I'd like a replacement jacket. Can you also tell me how to wash it in the meantime so it doesn't get worse?

The climbing helmet from order AO-418217 arrived damaged, there's a crack on the side and I think it was crushed in shipping. Photos attached. I'd like my money back, it was $540. Honestly I'm quite shaken that safety gear could arrive like this.
Can you change the shipping address on my order AO-418218 to my new address? I see it already says delivered but I'd like it updated.
Hi, I'd like to return the trekking poles from order AO-418219. Never used and still within the 30 days. Refund please.

Where is my order?? AO-418220. Tracking has said 'label created' for 12 days and hasn't moved at all. I needed this camping gear for a trip and I'm leaving soon. If it's lost just send me a new one, I've been patient enough.
Is the rain shell machine washable? I'm thinking about buying one.
I'd like to return the chalk bag and climbing shoes from order AO-418222. I used them outdoors once and they just aren't for me. Photos attached. Can I get a refund?
Order AO-418223: I received two left boots! Photos attached. Can I exchange them for a proper pair?

I'm disputing the card charge for order AO-418224 with my bank. You already delivered a replacement for an earlier problem with this order, but I'm still not happy and I want my money back. My card company told me to contact you as well.
Oops, I accidentally ordered the same item twice (order AO-418225). One of them is still unopened. Can I return it for a refund?
The shoulder strap stitching on my backpack came loose after normal use. I bought it about a year ago (order AO-418226). Photos attached. Can it be repaired or replaced under warranty?

The cooler I ordered arrived with a crack right down the side. I'm so annoyed, I was going to use it this weekend. I don't have the order number and I can't find the confirmation email anywhere. Photos attached. Please just send me a replacement.
Hi, I ordered a jacket 4 days ago (order AO-418228). It's unused, I just changed my mind. How do I return it for a refund?
Hello, I bought a climbing rope in July (order AO-418229) and after my first outing I noticed the sheath is abraded in one spot. Photos attached. I wanted to let you know. What should I do?
The tracking for order AO-418230 says delivered, but the carrier photo shows it at a different building, not mine. I went to that building and nobody has it. I want a refund.
Can I swap the jacket from order AO-418231 for a medium? The large is too big and I haven't worn it.

Hi, I need to talk to someone about the tent I bought (order AO-418232). I used it on one trip and honestly it just wasn't what I expected for $620. I know it's past your return window, but it's barely been used and I think an exception is fair. Photos attached. I'd like a refund. Also, does this tent come with a footprint? The website didn't say.
Does your backpacking water filter remove viruses? I'm travelling overseas and want to be sure.
This is the third time something I ordered has arrived damaged. The latest is order AO-418234, the jacket arrived damaged. Photos attached. I'd like a refund this time, I'm done with replacements.
My order AO-418235 was supposed to arrive two days ago and tracking still says in transit. Any update?

Hi, my climbing harness (order AO-418236, bought two years ago) is showing a lot of wear on the webbing. I climb several times a week so it gets frequent use, but I thought it would last longer. Photos attached. Can I get a replacement? I have a trip in two weeks, can I keep climbing on it until then?
I received a different jacket model than the one I ordered (order AO-418237). Photo attached. I'd just like a refund please.
I just placed order AO-418238 and realised it's going to my old address. It still says processing. Can you change the delivery address before it ships?
I'd like a refund for the unused hiking item from order AO-418239. I think a return label was already sent to me before but I can't find it. It's within 30 days.
The waterproof pants from order AO-418240 arrived with a torn seam. Photos attached. Can you send a replacement?
Can I use your camp stove indoors if it's raining? Just checking before my trip.

Hi, I ordered four jackets for my family for a group trip (order AO-418242) and the colours don't match each other at all. It was $1,200 total. I want a refund for all four. This was supposed to be a matching set for our trip photos and now it's ruined.

Hello? Is anyone there? My climbing gear order has had no tracking movement for 9 days now and it still says in transit. I'm starting to think it's lost. My trip is coming up and I really need it. For reference the order number is AO-418243. Please send a replacement if it's lost.
I bought a waterproof jacket (order AO-418244), washed it once and took the tags off. It doesn't fit the way I hoped. Can I still return it for a refund?
Hi, I heard there's a recall on some carabiners. My serial number is CB-77310-4482. Is mine included? I don't have my order number handy.

Hello. I'm writing about the roof tent I bought in January last year (order AO-418246). After 21 months the mechanism has completely failed. I've attached a video. For $740 I expected this to last many years. I would like a full refund. I've been a loyal customer and I hope you can sort this out quickly.
Can I exchange the backpack from order AO-418247 for a different colour? It's still unopened.
I'd like a refund for the jacket on order AO-418248, please send it to my card. Also note I've moved again, so use my newest address for anything you send.
